inventory.summary: Current executable sources fully support the bounded paragraph. Haskell `Program` stores an emitted `RawProgram` beside a typed `Plan '[] ()`; the production CLI inspects the former and executes the latter. Lean checks and observes serialized programs through the conformance oracle, whose committed corpus is replayed by Haskell tests. All five specialist roles have a current source, and no additional manual coverage is required.
